why:
Intro to Docker plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-docker.json), 'Build and tag your image' (passes: images my-site:1.0 and my-site:1.1 exist and a 1.1 container serves the new page). The learner edited index.html, then ran `docker tag my-site:1.0 my-site:1.1` instead of building: `docker images` lists both tags with the same IMAGE ID (3f1c2a9b8d7e, created 25 minutes ago), and the 1.1 container's page still says '

Trail log

', not 'v1.1'. The new page was never built into an image.

step.title: Build version 1.1 of the image
step.instructions: Change the heading in site/index.html to Trail log v1.1. Build it with docker build -t my-site:1.1 . and run docker images: you should see my-site with the tags 1.0 and 1.1. Start it with docker run -d -p 8081:80 my-site:1.1 and open localhost:8081.

Terminal: tripi@mac my-site % docker tag my-site:1.0 my-site:1.1
REPOSITORY   TAG       IMAGE ID       CREATED          SIZE
tripi@mac my-site % curl -s localhost:8081 | grep h1
